info.name: Plex Media Server Play Queue API

params.name: uri
params.description: The content URI for what we're playing.

params.name: playlistID
params.description: the ID of the playlist we're playing.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of play queue to create

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the first item to play, defaults to the first in the play queue.

params.name: shuffle
params.description: Whether to shuffle the playlist, defaults to 0.

params.name: repeat
params.description: If the PQ is bigger than the window, fill any empty space with wraparound items, defaults to 0.

params.name: continuous
params.description: Whether to create a continuous play queue (e.g. from an episode), defaults to 0.

params.name: extrasPrefixCount
params.description: Number of trailers to prepend a movie with not including the pre-roll. If omitted the pre-roll will not be returned in the play queue. When resuming a movie `extrasPrefixCount` should be omitted as a parameter instead of passing 0.

params.name: recursive
params.description: Only applies to queues of type photo, whether to retrieve all descendent photos from an album or section, defaults to 1.

params.name: onDeck
params.description: Only applies to queues of type show or seasons, whether to return a queue that is started on the On Deck episode if one exists. Otherwise begins the play queue on the beginning of the show or season.

items.docs:
Makes a new play queue for a device. The source of the playqueue can either be a URI, or a playlist. The response is a media container with the initial items in the queue. Each item in the queue will be a regular item but with `playQueueItemID` - a unique ID since the queue could have repeated items with the same `ratingKey`.
Note: Either `uri` or `playlistID` must be specified

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

params.name: own
params.description: If the server should transfer ownership to the requesting client (used in remote control scenarios).

params.name: center
params.description: The play queue item ID for the center of the window - this doesn't change the current selected item.

params.name: window
params.description: How many items on each side of the center of the window

params.name: includeBefore
params.description: Whether to include the items before the center (if 0, center is not included either), defaults to 1.

params.name: includeAfter
params.description: Whether to include the items after the center (if 0, center is not included either), defaults to 1.

items.docs: Retrieves the play queue, centered at current item. This can be treated as a regular container by play queue-oblivious clients, but they may wish to request a large window onto the queue since they won't know to refresh.

info.name: Add a generator or playlist to a play queue

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

params.name: uri
params.description: The content URI for what we're adding to the queue.

params.name: playlistID
params.description: The ID of the playlist to add to the playQueue.

params.name: next
params.description: Play this item next (defaults to 0 - queueing at the end of manually queued items).

items.docs: Adds an item to a play queue (e.g. party mode). Increments the version of the play queue. Takes the following parameters (`uri` and `playlistID` are mutually exclusive). Returns the modified play queue.

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

items.docs: Deletes all items in the play queue, and increases the version of the play queue.

info.name: Delete an item from a play queue

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

params.name: playQueueItemId
params.description: The play queue item ID to delete.

items.docs: Deletes an item in a play queue. Increments the version of the play queue. Returns the modified play queue.

info.name: Move an item in a play queue

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

params.name: playQueueItemId
params.description: The play queue item ID to delete.

params.name: after
params.description: The play queue item ID to insert the new item after. If not present, moves to the beginning.

items.docs: Moves an item in a play queue, and increases the version of the play queue. Returns the modified play queue.

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

items.docs: Reset a play queue to the first item being the current item

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

items.docs: Shuffle a play queue (or reshuffles if already shuffled). The currently selected item is maintained. Note that this is currently only supported for play queues *without* an Up Next area. Returns the modified play queue.

params.name: playQueueId
params.description: The ID of the play queue.

items.docs: Unshuffles a play queue and restores "natural order". Note that this is currently only supported for play queues *without* an Up Next area. Returns the modified play queue.
